verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of natural-language operation is the campaign agent, which lets a user start from a goal and have the agent plan an entire campaign. Generative content creation is also mentioned. Neither item documents general natural-language commands for operating the product, such as creating, sending or querying emails by instruction. The MCP server probe concerns a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented general-purpose natural-language command interface, scope of actions the agent can execute, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Start from a goal and let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance.
Create blog posts, social content, and landing pages grounded in your brand voice, audience data, and competitor research.
